summary: ethresear.ch 提出 GhostPool：加密内存池虽隐藏交易内容，但准入路径仍暴露发送者与 nonce 等身份关键元数据，文章探讨如何隐藏。chunter-cb 提交让 EIP-8130 支持无许可 payer。ACDT #73 跟进 Glamsterdam devnet；同周 EF Protocol 的 gas 重定价调查显示 builder 担心 EIP-8037 多维 gas 与 EIP-8038 状态访问成本的复杂度。

items.topic: 交易隐私：加密内存池的元数据
items.title: ethresear.ch：GhostPool，在加密内存池准入中隐藏身份关键元数据
items.note: （wonj1012）23:37：加密内存池在打包前隐藏交易内容，但多数设计的准入路径仍暴露发送者与 nonce，或起同样作用的公开信封签名者，因为动态内存池检查依赖这些字段。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: GhostPool, hiding identity critical metadata in encrypted mempool admission
items.note_en: (wonj1012), 23:37: encrypted mempools hide contents before inclusion, but most designs still expose sender and nonce, or an equivalent public envelope signer, on admission because dynamic mempool checks rely on them.

summary_en: An ethresear.ch post proposed GhostPool: encrypted mempools hide contents but the admission path still exposes identity critical metadata such as sender and nonce, and the post explores hiding it. chunter-cb submitted permissionless payers for EIP-8130. ACDT #73 followed up on Glamsterdam devnets, and the same week EF Protocol's gas repricing survey showed builders worried about the complexity of EIP-8037 multidimensional gas and EIP-8038 state access costs.
